why: sub_10021B70 returns its view matrix (this + 4) in eax, but the IDB types it `float __thiscall`, so Hex-Rays read no integer result and left v3 (eax) unassigned; the reconstruction passed garbage to CDx_SetTransform and copied the matrix from it.
evidence: disasm 0x10021B9B: lea eax,[esi+4]; pop esi; ret (no x87 result). Caller 0x10015559..0x10015578: mov esi,eax after the call; push esi to CDx_SetTransform(2, ...); rep movsd from esi for Camera_SetViewMatrix. Type corrected in data/type_fixes.json.
